summary: Family on the inside: {family member} works for your campaign or near your office, and {go-between} offers them something you would never take yourself.
realLife: One life: During the 2016 race his eldest son, who also ran the family company, took a meeting offered with the promise of damaging material on the rival. Emails released in 2017 showed its purpose. Another: In 2002, while her father was vice president, she took a State Department post that critics said was created for her. In 2016 she won the Wyoming House seat he had held from 1979 to 1989.
